sources.title: SinD: A Drone Dataset at Signalized Intersection in China
sources.supports: Original SinD provenance; not statistics for our two public v2 recordings

sources.title: SinD 2.0: A Multi-City UAV Dataset with Semantic Risk Annotations for SOTIF-Oriented Safety Validation at Signalized Intersections
sources.supports: Multi-city intersection context; section VI reports 50/60 QCNet and31/52 Diffuser protocols, explicitly not a standardized leaderboard; smoothing causality not established

sources.title: InterHub: A Naturalistic Trajectory Dataset with Dense Interaction for Autonomous Driving
sources.supports: Interaction is predicted conflict/behavioral dependence, not density alone; trajectory-event extraction cannot be imported as online inclusion unmodified

sources.title: SMART: Scalable Multi-agent Real-time Simulation via Next-token Prediction
sources.supports: Motion tokens and temporal/agent interaction factorization; 50m neighboring-agent radius in section3.2; not proof of textual GPT2 pretraining advantage

sources.title: One Fits All: Power General Time Series Analysis by Pretrained LM
sources.supports: Positive evidence for pretrained frozen transformer transfer under studied time-series settings, especially small-data ablations; not SinD-specific

sources.title: Are Language Models Actually Useful for Time Series Forecasting?
sources.supports: Counterevidence: removal/replacement and random-init ablations often retain or improve accuracy; requires controlled pretraining tests

sources.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
sources.supports: Frozen W plus low-rank BA adaptation; parameter efficiency does not prove domain-transfer accuracy

sources.title: Kinematics-Aware Multigraph Attention Network with Residual Learning for Heterogeneous Trajectory Prediction
sources.supports: Physics-plus-residual graph forecasting precedent, not causal identification of pure interaction residual

sources.title: FHWA SSAM Software User Manual
sources.supports: TTC/PET conflict thresholds, e.g.1.5s; not justification for equating TCPA with TTC or declaring DCPA5m an industry standard

sources.title: Argoverse Motion Forecasting User Guide
sources.supports: Target/context distinction and multi-second trajectory scenes; do not copy raw metrics across tasks
sources.publication_date_status: official living documentation; publication year not established
